relevance_note: Cohort study of ABCA1 heterozygotes and TD patients whose Table 3 lists individual carriers by label with their mutation and vascular disease, e.g. "| TD1-363                   | C1477R              | 30            | MI (51)".
method_note: Cohort of 77 ABCA1 heterozygotes from 11 families plus 5 TD patients and 156 unaffected family members; only Table 3 gives individual-level data, so rows are the 14 people in Table 3 (the TD proband TD1, 8 heterozygotes, and 5 unaffected family members recorded as tested-negative relatives, mutation 'none', who get no variant rows). Table 3 was transcribed by a short Python script that copies cell text from the Markdown; I checked its output against the table. Family labels are taken from the family prefix of each individual label (e.g. FHA5-215 -> FHA5), matching the family names in Table 2. Table 3 Exon column (e.g. 30, intron 25, 22, 41, 48) has no schema field and is not recorded. Variant notation is legacy (no c./p.); protein-style strings are put in protein_hgvs_as_stated as printed; 'ivs25+1GfiC' is printed with a garbled arrow ('fi') and kept as printed. TD1 carries C1477R and ivs25+1GfiC; zygosity left not reported (paper only says 'Patients with mutations on both alleles'). TD4-201's variant is 'unidentified' (TD4 second mutation not found; heterozygosity assigned by haplotype), so the variant row has variant_original_string 'not reported' and zygosity not reported. Heterozygous zygosity for the other 7 carriers comes from the Table 3 group header 'ABCA1 heterozygotes'. Only M1091T gets a stated variant type (missense) and a functional statement; other variant classes were described only generally (severe vs missense) and are not reported. FHA3-301 CAD is from the Methods sentence that FHA2-301 and FHA3-301 were referred on the basis of CAD; Table 3 lists FHA3-301 only with PVD (<54). PVD and CVA were recorded as features but not mapped to the non-coronary atherosclerotic checklist item. AP (angina) counted as CAD per the text ('CAD was manifest as angina in two cases'); TIA not counted as CAD. '-' cells in Table 3 are undefined and treated as not reported. Smoking and BMI risk factors were not recorded as phenotypes. Group means (HDL-C, apoAI, TG, LDL in Tables 1, 2 and 4) are not individual-level and were not assigned to anyone. The sentence 'Patients with mutations on both alleles manifest with splenomegaly alone or in association with CAD (TD1; data not shown)' was judged too ambiguous to mark splenomegaly for TD1. Possible inconsistencies in the paper: the text says heterozygotes had 'myocardial infarctions (five, one fatal)' but Table 3 lists MI for four heterozygotes; the text says CAD in unaffected individuals was 'angina in two cases and ... a transient ischemic attack', but Table 3 also lists MI for two unaffected members (FHA2-315, TD1-205). n_patients_reported is the 77 heterozygotes as stated; the 5 TD patients are reported separately in Table 1.
